text: Compton Medical Centre has filed 56 claims in under a year of registration while reporting zero beds, one affiliated doctor, and an office address it shares with the broker who arranged 94.6 percent of its inflow, Alicia Warner. Every payout — 92.9 percent — lands in a single account, and every patient in its history visited exactly once and never appears anywhere else in the graph. Each of these facts has an honest twin (day clinics have no beds; exclusive referral partnerships exist; small clinics bank in one place), but this clinic stacks five strong features at once — thin roster, tiny footprint, single feeder, concentrated payout, all-transient patients — and that combination does not occur among the graph's legitimate day clinics. The honest alternative would be a genuinely new satellite clinic whose founding partner is also its facilitator; that story does not explain the fully transient patient base. Next step: request proof of physical operations — lease, staffing, equipment — and hold payouts to account ACC_001602 pending the answer.
